title: ‘Future of youth is not negotiable’: PDP MLA Parra seeks probe into FAA cheating racket, stay on JKPSI exam

ai.summary: PDP MLA Parra demanded an investigation into alleged cheating in JKSSB exams and a stay on upcoming J&K Police Sub-Inspector and Constable exams until the probe concludes, citing the recruitment system's failure to provide fair opportunities for youth.

facts.claim: PDP MLA Parra demanded a thorough investigation into the cheating racket unearthed during the Finance Accounts Assistant examination
facts.quote: Srinagar, Nov 17: Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) leader and MLA Pulwama, Waheed-ur-Rehman Parra Tuesday demanded a thorough investigation into the cheating racket unearthed during the Finance Accounts Assistant (FAA) examination

facts.claim: Parra called for putting the upcoming Jammu and Kashmir Police Sub-Inspector (JKPSI) and Police Constable examinations on hold until the investigation establishes the truth
facts.quote: He expressed concern over the move and called for putting the upcoming Jammu and Kashmir Police Sub-Inspector (JKPSI) and Police Constable examinations on hold until the "investigation establishes the truth."

facts.claim: Parra said repeated paper leaks, recruitment scams and compromises had turned the aspirations of Jammu and Kashmir’s youth into a "cycle of uncertainty and betrayal"
facts.quote: Parra said repeated paper leaks, recruitment scams and compromises had turned the aspirations of Jammu and Kashmir’s youth into a "cycle of uncertainty and betrayal"

facts.claim: Jammu Police apprehended 14 persons for allegedly attempting to facilitate cheating through electronic communication devices during the JKSSB Finance Accounts Assistant examination
facts.quote: Jammu Police apprehended 14 persons for allegedly attempting to facilitate cheating through electronic communication devices during the JKSSB Finance Accounts Assistant examination held on November 15.

facts.claim: Police seized eight wireless sets, around 22 mobile phones and five vehicles during an operation
facts.quote: Jammu Police seized eight wireless sets, around 22 mobile phones and five vehicles during an operation launched following intelligence inputs about a suspected network planning to help candidates cheat in the examination.

facts.claim: The CBI investigated the alleged paper leak and filed a chargesheet against several accused
facts.quote: In July 2022, the administration cancelled the selection process for 1,200 Police Sub-Inspector posts following allegations of irregularities in the written examination conducted by JKSSB on March 27 of 2022. The CBI subsequently investigated the alleged paper leak and filed a chargesheet against several accused.

ai.background_note: The JKSSB exam cheating scandal has led to repeated cancellations of recruitment processes, with the CBI investigating past incidents and the current probe demanding a stay on upcoming police exams.
